ar-appeals-judges.area: Arkansas — all seven Court of Appeals districts
ar-appeals-judges.summary: Your Court of Appeals District card says which district you are in and how many of the court's twelve judges its voters elect, and names none of them yet.
ar-appeals-judges.why: The court publishes its judges district by district, and this app does not read that list yet.
ar-appeals-judges.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

ar-circuit-judges.summary: Your Judicial Circuit card says which circuit you are in and how many judges its voters elect, and names none of them yet.
ar-circuit-judges.why: The court system's directory names every circuit judge, and this app does not read it yet. In five circuits a federal court order divides the voters into two subdistricts, and which judges each one elects has not been read.
ar-circuit-judges.wanted: Nothing from a reader for the names, which are ours to build. For the five divided circuits, a published list of which judgeships each subdistrict elects.

ar-fire-district-boards.summary: Your Fire District card says which fire district the state's map puts you in and the counties it serves, and not who runs it.
ar-fire-district-boards.why: The state's map of fire districts names each district and its counties and no one who runs it, and no statewide list of who runs each district has been read. This app never guesses a name.
ar-fire-district-boards.wanted: A statewide list naming who runs each fire district and how to reach it, published by a state office, or each county's own list.

ar-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which Arkansas city or town you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
ar-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Arkansas's mayors and council members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
ar-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of mayors and council members, or each city's own published list.

ar-quorum-court.concept: Justice of the peace by district
ar-quorum-court.summary: In some districts the Quorum Court District card names no justice of the peace, because the person elected there in 2024 has since left, or because no one won, or because the names cannot be matched with certainty.
ar-quorum-court.why: No Arkansas government publishes who sits for each district statewide. Names come from a county's own site or the county association's 2024 results, and neither says who replaced a justice who left.
ar-quorum-court.wanted: Each county's justices of the peace listed by district on the county's own website, or one statewide list by district from a state office.

ar-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people elected to run it.
ar-school-board-members.why: Arkansas's school boards are elected, and no statewide list of their members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
ar-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.
